name: Copperplate Engine
author: kolache
description: A Victorian calculating engine prints its replies on cream cards that hang from one brass rail; you type yours on a typewriter carriage. Hand-tinted engravings of a glass-and-iron engine hall by day, gaslight and Prussian blue by night.
